Write a program using user-defined function to find the sum of N odd numbers.  BY ANKIT ADHIKARI(725)
snippets.code:
#include <stdio.h>    int sum_of_odd_numbers(int n) {    /** Function to calculate the sum of the first N odd numbers. **/     int sum_odd = 0;    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {    int odd_number = 2 * i + 1;  // Calculate the ith odd number    sum_odd += odd_number;        // Add it to the sum    }    return sum_odd;    }    int main() {    // Input: Number of odd numbers to sum    int N;    printf("Enter the number of odd numbers to sum: ");    scanf("%d", &N);    int result = sum_of_odd_numbers(N);    printf("The sum of the first %d odd numbers is: %d
", N, result);    return 0;    }
